source.note: Genre-neutral reference acceptance template for the 3d-topdown-arena (twin-stick) SEED — the FIRST contract for the empty 3D top-down / twin-stick quadrant (dogfood findings RCL-F01/RCL-F02). The existing 3d-shooter pack hard-codes an OVER-SHOULDER THIRD-PERSON rig (framing.cameraMode: 'third-person-follow', projection: perspective, FOV 60, 'player reads near screen-center'); a top-down extraction-shooter / twin-stick arena is framed from ABOVE, looking DOWN, with the play space reading top-down and the camera leading the aim/movement vector — NOT the player parked at screen-center. This contract NAMES that top-down framing so the quadrant is no longer empty. It exercises the same required, genre-neutral contract sections (fonts/palette/hud/framing/feel/manifest/win) as 3d-shooter and validates against the SAME validateAcceptanceContract; it deliberately OMITS the platformer-only optional sections. The feel section carries the core measure-only metrics that bind to implemented calculators today (fireIntervalMs, ttkMs, cameraFollowDamping). The camera FEEL dial — cameraFollowDamping (camera half-life + look-ahead) — binds to deriveCameraFollowDamping, the calculator the dogfood 'camera half-life 0.10-0.18s, look-ahead 2-4m' spec needed and nothing could measure before. This is a seed for `plan --genre 3d-topdown-arena`, not a hand-tuned shipping contract.

elements.note: Max 3 hearts; lost slot stays an empty pip so layout never shifts.

perspectiveFallback.note: If a perspective rig is used instead of orthographic, it is a HIGH, steeply-down-tilted rig (pitch in pitchDownDeg, narrow FOV), NOT a 60 FOV over-shoulder camera. The play space must still read top-down.

visibleGroundWidthM.note: MACHINE-CHECKABLE FRAME SCALE: the visible ground-plane width the camera may show, in world metres (measured at frame centre). Exemplar band = the dogfood truth-sheet's ~24-32m arena read. The framing gate computes the width from the CAPTURED camera evidence — for an orthographic rig width = 2·orthographicSize·aspect (here 2·9·16/9 = 32m, at the band edge); for a perspective rig width = 2·(h/sin(pitch))·aspect·tan(FOV/2) from the captured height/pitch/FOV. This is the gate that would have caught the dogfood project's ~54m over-wide frame (character-as-a-speck) that sat unnoticed until a human eyeballed it. When this band is declared, a missing captured camera height/pitch/FOV is a REFUSAL, never a skipped check.

camera.note: Top-down / high-angle rig framing a bounded arena from ABOVE looking DOWN. Either orthographic (a flat top-down read) or a high, steeply-pitched perspective rig (pitchDownDeg 55-90, where 90 is straight down). This is the empty 3D top-down / twin-stick quadrant — explicitly NOT the 3d-shooter pack's over-shoulder third-person rig (perspective, FOV 60, player near screen-center).

playerAnchor.note: TWIN-STICK look-ahead framing: the player is NOT parked at screen-center. The camera leads the aim/movement vector, so the player rides BEHIND the look-ahead point and the loose tolerance reflects that lead. Informational; the per-frame follow behavior is measured by cameraFollowDamping, not asserted here.

lookAhead.note: The camera biases toward the aim/movement vector by ~2-4m so the player sees where they are heading/aiming. Measured by deriveCameraFollowDamping.lookAheadOffset; this is design intent, not a gate band.

framing.note: 16:9 top-down arena. The play space reads top-down (high-angle / orthographic), NOT an over-shoulder third-person frame. No 2D pixel-frame claims (no native-resolution / pixel-scale).

fireIntervalMs.note: cadence between shots; measure-only, binds to the fireIntervalMs calculator (dimension-agnostic counter edges)

ttkMs.note: first-hit to reference-enemy death; measure-only, binds to the ttkMs calculator (hit/death edges)

cameraFollowDampingHalfLifeMs.note: twin-stick camera CATCH-UP half-life (time to close half the gap to the follow target). dogfood spec 0.10-0.18s. Measure-only, binds to deriveCameraFollowDamping.halfLifeMs; honest-or-omit (refuses when the camera does not follow). NOT yet a gate-enforced band.

cameraLookAheadMeters.note: twin-stick camera steady look-ahead lead toward the movement/aim vector. dogfood spec 2-4m. Measure-only, binds to deriveCameraFollowDamping.lookAheadOffset. NOT yet a gate-enforced band.

wallSlideTangentRatio.note: WALL-SLIDE FEEL GATE (dogfood learnings §2 / backlog High #2): the fraction of the diagonal input's TANGENTIAL speed the character preserves while PINNED against a wall — 1.0 is a perfect collide-and-slide (removes only the into-wall velocity component), 0 is the FROZEN controller the dogfood project shipped by accident. Measure-only, binds to deriveWallSlideTangentRatio (dimension-agnostic on the XZ ground plane; refuses a non-into-wall input or an unpinned sample). BAND IS A DESIGN CHOICE (the doc's 'projected speed vs full-speed arcade slide' tunable): the default `abs 0.4` accepts [0.6, 1.4] — an ARCADE floor of 0.6 (still glances along the wall) up to a full-speed arcade redirect that keeps the whole input magnitude (>1.0). Tighten to `abs 0.1` ([0.9, 1.1]) for a strict PROJECTED slide that must preserve nearly the full tangential component. NOT yet a gate-enforced band. A zero-friction player collider material is the paired structural fix; deriveWallSlideTangentRatio reports collider friction when the capture carries it.

hitStop.note: Design intent — brief impact freeze on enemy hit/kill. Binds to deriveHitstopMs when captured; this ms target stays design intent, not a gate band.

screenShake.note: Design intent — small kick on fire, larger on hit/kill. The top-down camera shake is distinct from the cameraFollowDamping follow signal (a transient punch vs the steady follow); binds to deriveScreenShakeMag when captured. Design intent, not a gate band.

win.note: Win when every reference enemy in the arena is defeated; reaching a zero-enemy state flips the GameManager win flag. (A full extraction loop — reach-zone -> dwell -> bank, lose-on-death — binds to the extraction calculators in a later slice.)

verification.note: Derived from the sections this contract deliberately OMITS (platformer/reachability/placement/props), one gate per omitted section: platform-tiles + tile-render + parallax-motion walk `platformer`, reachability walks `reachability`, placement walks `placement`, prop-purpose walks `props` + `placement`. Same rule promote.ts applies to a promoted GenreContract, and the same set _generic declares. Without this block a WHOLE-GAME verify left the platformer-shaped gates APPLICABLE for a top-down arena. prop-purpose is the sharp one here: an arena is the genre most likely to carry cover/decor props, and with no `props` section declared the gate would fail every prop that is neither collider-bearing nor listed as intentional decor, i.e. grade a taste this contract never set. The slice DAG requests none of these six, so nothing here can make a slice unreachable-green.
